labels: An open laboratory coat covers a school outfit, its lapels and patch pockets visible while safety goggles rest over the wearer's eyes.; 열린 실험 가운이 교복 위를 덮고 라펠과 덧주머니가 보이며 보안경이 착용자의 눈 위에 놓인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: An open laboratory coat covers a school outfit, its lapels and patch pockets visible while safety goggles rest over the wearer's eyes.
aliases: 실험 가운의 겉옷 층
